## 2. The service

MYEZ helps you compare two products. It gathers reviews and prices from public sources, uses AI to compile specifications from search results and, where those say nothing, from the AI model's general knowledge, and uses AI to write a verdict. MYEZ is a decision aid: it does not sell products, and prices come from third-party retailers and can change.

## 3. Eligibility and your account

- You must be at least 13 years old to create an account.<PLACEHOLDER:MINORS_CLAUSE>

## 4. Free use and limits

Use of MYEZ is free. Each account can run a limited number of comparisons (currently 3 a day and up to 10 a month, after 3 introductory comparisons). We may change these limits. This version of the App sells no subscriptions or in-app purchases.

## 6. AI-generated content and accuracy

Verdicts, summaries and recommendations are generated by AI from public information and may be incomplete or wrong. Prices may be converted from another currency or out of date; check with the retailer before you buy. Nothing in MYEZ is medical, health, financial or professional advice; for supplements and health products, consult a qualified professional.

## 9. Smart Decision Referrals

When you share a MYEZ comparison with a friend, you may earn rewards.

**How rewards work:** you can be the source of up to **3 successful invites per device** for the lifetime of that device. When a friend you invited completes their first real comparison while signed in, you earn 5 additional comparisons, added to your bonus balance.

**Fair use:** rewards may be withheld for self-referral, automated sign-ups, fake accounts or coordinated rings. To detect abuse we use device identifiers, email address checks and timing signals. Rewards cannot be transferred, have no cash value and expire 7 days after they are granted.

**What others see:** people who open a comparison or invite link you share see that comparison, without the parts personalised for you. People who open an invite link you share can also see your display name. If you joined through a friend's invite, the notification we send that friend can show your display name.

## 10. Notifications

If you allow notifications, we may send you referral updates (for example when a friend you invited completes their first comparison, or before a referral reward expires) and up to one reminder a week about your past comparisons. We do not send advertising. <PLACEHOLDER:INAPP_NOTIF_CLAUSE>

- **Reviews:** review summaries are generated by AI and may not represent every buyer's opinion.
- **Recommendations:** recommendations are generated by AI from the available data and your preferences. They are not professional advice.
